content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

Not necessarily. 💪 Research shows you can build similar muscle with lighter loads (roughly 30-60% of 1RM, around 15-30 reps) as long as you take sets close to failure. Heavier work in the 5-10 rep range is more time-efficient, and it's the only kind that builds the max strength your 100 kg bench goal needs.

For you, I'd mix both. Keep your main bench work heavy, and use moderate-to-higher rep accessories for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
